name: Fuel Assistance (Home Energy Assistance / LIHEAP)
description: Free program that helps pay part of winter heating costs. Covers deliverable fuels (oil, kerosene, propane, coal, wood, pellets, biobricks), natural gas and electricity, and may help with heat included in rent. Expedited help for heating emergencies (November 1 - April 30), such as running out of fuel or a gas/electric shut-off notice.
contact: 413-774-2310 or 800-370-0940 (toll-free); fuelassistance@communityaction.us (do not email confidential information)
documents_needed: State or federally-issued photo ID for the applicant
Proof of citizenship or qualified alien status
Verification of all sources of income for the 30 days prior to the appointment
Dates of birth for all household members
Heating vendor, account number, and name of account holder
Renters: copy of lease (and verification of rental subsidy, if applicable)
Homeowners: mortgage, homeowner's insurance, and property tax bills
College students: current financial aid awards

requirements.text: 2026-2027 income guidelines, based on the size of the entire household (everyone who benefits from the heat): 1: $53,585; 2: $70,073; 3: $86,561; 4: $103,049; 5: $119,536; 6: $136,024; 7: $139,116; 8: $142,207; 9: $145,299; 10: $148,390. The page does not state whether these are yearly or gross amounts.
Fuel Assistance may pay for heat included in rent; renters provide a copy of their lease.
Apply anytime between October 1st and April 30th in person, on the phone or online.
Proof of citizenship, qualified alien status or unqualified alien status is requested for all household members.
Community Action Pioneer Valley serves Hampshire County (it took on responsibility for Hampshire County in 2005) and Franklin County; offices in Greenfield, Northampton and Orange.
